description: Send the Fudge team a problem with its tools, a capability you needed, or feedback the merchant asked you to pass on.

message.description: Up to 250 words, starting with a one-line summary. For a problem: what you did, what the tools returned and what would have made it easy. For missing: the task, what you did instead and what the tool could look like. For merchant: their words as they put them. Leave out personal details nobody asked you to send.

store.description: The connected store to use. Defaults to the first one.

type.description: broken: a Fudge tool failed or did the wrong thing. stuck: you couldn’t finish the task with Fudge’s tools. hard: the tools made the task much harder than it should be. missing: the task needed something Fudge’s tools can’t do. merchant: the merchant asked you to pass this on; only when they ask.

name: send_feedback
title: Send feedback to Fudge
